## Source inspected
The PDF was read. It is a later training deck. It does not reproduce a 1994 ministry instrument.
:::

| URL | [IFRC Society PDF](https://www.ifrcsociety.org/documents/resources/slides/getting-started/CSIL-Module-Series_Module-1.pdf) |

: Identification

## Annotation

This deck is one public source of the **1994** start-year claim. Closely worded IFRC and ALS Society of BC workshop slides repeat 1994. [Kelly et al. 2020](kelly-2020-directly-funded.qmd) also writes “Initiated in 1994.” A different IFRC deck uses **1993**. This archive does not pick a winner.

The same deck describes Phase I / Phase II, says funding comes from the home-support budget, and states there is no wait list and no ministry policy requiring six months on an agency.

## Open questions

- Date the slides were prepared.
- Whether “established … in 1994” means authorization, first clients, or province-wide availability.
